purpose: T93 validation of the T89 post-settlement negative tilt on the expanded hourly PIT cohort: are bars 0-2h after an 8h funding settlement genuinely negative-tilted (alpha), a funding-payment/mark-index settlement mechanical artifact, or underpowered noise. Measurement only - no fitting, no trading, no profitability claims.

cohort.label: label.forward_return_bps (perp_forward_mark_return_up_25bps_4h_gross; numeric bps present on all 17960 records)
cohort.t89_finding_under_test: post-settlement bars (decision_ms mod 28800000 < 7200000) vs rest: -4.8bps mean 4h forward tilt, p~0.005

checks.V1_funding_sign_split: post and rest bars split by settled last_funding_rate sign (>0/<0/=0); mechanical-artifact hypothesis predicts dip concentrated in funding>0. Auxiliary: mean mark_index_basis_bps post vs rest (basis discontinuity check)
checks.V2_conditioning_grid: post-vs-rest tilt within trailing-90-record per-asset mid-rank percentile terciles of last_funding_rate (funding_pct) and realized_vol_24h (rv_pct), and within each asset
checks.V3_horizon: forward mark returns recomputed from features.mark_price series at 1h/2h/4h per asset (mark-derived 4h verified against the label); tilt vs rest at each horizon
checks.V4_economics: compare gross tilt to 5bps/side taker assumption (10bps round trip); state tradability honestly and frame value as diagnostic contamination of other signals' evaluation windows
checks.V5_stability: per-UTC-month post-vs-rest tilt (sign report) plus full 8h cycle-position profile (sawtooth check: is the dip settlement-centered rather than uniquely post-settlement)

statistics.test: Welch two-sample t, normal-approx two-sided p (same convention as financial_signal_regime_v1 / financial_signal_funding_timing_v1); min n=10 per side
statistics.multiple_testing: BH-FDR alpha=0.05 over the evaluated contrast family (<=8)
caveats: 4h forward labels on 1h bars overlap ~4x (2x at 2h horizon) -> positive autocorrelation; Welch t nominal, p-values optimistic
cross-asset bars sharing a timestamp are correlated through the common market factor; pooled n overstates effective sample size
mark-derived forward returns reuse only features.mark_price already in the records; series tails lose the last ~4 bars per asset per horizon
